Adjuncts "are given access to the Research Ethics Board (REB)" and "are eligible to apply through CMCC to external research granting agencies" (EVD-0220). A DC in private practice can seek the appointment as an individual without AOI or other sponsorship, so the value is Independent; it is an affiliation route, not funding.

records.program_name: NIH Extramural Loan Repayment Program for Clinical Researchers (LRP-CR)
records.eligible_study_types: any qualifying clinical research (patient-oriented, human subjects)
records.additional_eligibility_requirements: Research must be supported by a domestic nonprofit (AOI or another nonprofit or university) or US government agency; US citizen, national or permanent resident; doctoral degree (DC listed); at least 20 hours a week of qualifying research for 2 years; educational debt of at least 20% of institutional base salary; no research funding or salary from a for-profit organization (whether practice income counts is unresolved).
records.eligibility_notes: Repays up to USD 50,000 a year of educational debt; it does not fund a project. DCs are eligible but need 20+ hours a week of research sponsored by a nonprofit or government agency (a university, AOI if eligible, or another nonprofit).

details.applicant_restrictions: Doctoral degree including D.C.; >=20 h/week of qualifying research for >=2 years supported by a domestic nonprofit (501) or US government entity; educational debt >=20% of institutional base salary; ineligible if receiving research funding support or salary from a for-profit organization; Institutional Business Official must certify. US citizens, nationals, or permanent residents (stated in NOT-OD-26-081).
details.independent_clinician_notes: Loan repayment (paid to lender on the researcher's behalf), not a research grant. D.C. degree is explicitly eligible. A chiropractor could potentially qualify if conducting >=20 h/week of clinical research sponsored by a nonprofit such as AOI (501(c)(3)) whose business official certifies salary and support. Major uncertainties: whether income from the clinician's own for-profit practice triggers the for-profit exclusion; whether AOI can credibly certify 'institutional base salary'. Confirm with NIH Division of Loan Repayment.
application_requirements: Research plan, mentor/recommender letters (standard LRP; not verified)
details.allowable_expenses_notes: Not applicable - repays qualified educational debt only.
details.relevance_notes: Chiropractors often carry high educational debt; a part-time research role at AOI could, if eligible, unlock up to $50,000/yr in loan repayment. Requires a substantial (>=20 h/week) research commitment.
details.aoi_affiliation_reasoning: Applicants may hold a 'D.C.' degree, but their research must be 'supported by a domestic nonprofit foundation (e.g., universities) or U.S. government agency' (EVD-0051), certified by the sponsor's business official (EVD-0052), and they are ineligible if they 'receive any research funding support or salary from a for-profit institution or organization' (EVD-0333).
